ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.guar: When a blow would kill you, you survive it and recover 25% / 50% / 75% of your maximum health.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.seco: Dropping below 30% health steadies you with Regeneration I / II / III for 30 seconds.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.bloo: Every second kill leaves you hunting, with Strength I / I / II and Speed I for 8 / 10 / 12 seconds.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.swif: Once you have taken 10 damage, the next hit sends you moving with Speed I / I / II for 10 / 15 / 15 seconds.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.spid: You climb any wall like a spider.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.wate: Sprint across the surface of still water. Slow down or stop and you drop in.
ability.playerabilities_mortalboons.echo: Breaking a block has a 25% / 40% / 60% chance to also break a matching block beside it.
